subject: Workplace Skills
title: Flagging Risks Early
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Flagging Risks Early.

hook.text: The Titanic lookout spotted the iceberg too late to turn. At work, late warnings are equally catastrophic.

buildup.text: People delay sharing bad news hoping it will resolve itself. It almost never does. It just gets worse.

discovery.text: Bosses forgive early warnings. They rarely forgive late surprises. The earlier you flag, the more options exist.

twist.text: You don't need a solution to flag a risk. 'I see a potential issue and wanted you to know early' is enough.

climax.text: Use a traffic light system: green on track, yellow at risk, red blocked. This gives bosses a quick read.

punchline.text: Flag early. Options shrink with every silent day.

quiz.question: Why is it better to flag risks early without a solution?
options: It shifts blame to your boss for not solving it
Early awareness creates more options for everyone to respond
Your boss is required to solve any flagged risk
